summary: Celestine (The Wailer) is a Legendary Ice Support hero featured in a targeted summon banner available until October 28. He holds official S-tier ratings for Survival, Support, and PvE. His kit turns 20% of taken damage into teamwide healing every 5 seconds, provides team shields and Defense Up II (+60%), cleanses control effects and debuffs, and applies Karmic Sin to strongest enemies. Overall, he acts as a high-value defensive cleaner and shielder for durable teams.
